device.description: 10-bit 400 kSPS 4-channel serial SAR ADC with internal reference, 8-level FIFO and auto power down
device.note: tlc1514.pdf (SLAS252) p.1 pinouts, p.3-4 terminal functions, p.5 output data format, p.6 Table 1 command set, p.7 Table 2 CFR, p.8-9 conversion modes, p.10-17 timing diagrams (Figures 2-14), p.18-19 conversion speed and power down, p.19-20 recommended operating conditions and timing, p.21 self-test codes and tconv, p.25 Figure 19

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.7 Table 2: configuration register (D15-D12 of the write word are the command); power-on value not documented

commands.name: Select analog input channel 0-3
commands.note: p.6 Table 1: TLC1514 channels 0-3 are 0000b, 0010b, 0100b, 0110b (odd codes N/A); sampling starts after the 4th SCLK, the conversion after the 16th (short sampling) or 28th SCLK (p.8); committed at CS rise here

commands.name: SW power down
commands.note: p.6 Table 1 / p.19: 8000h powers down analog + reference; modeled as no-op (the wake-up event is not documented)

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.6 Table 1, p.10 Figures 2-3: SDO outputs CFR D11-D0 after the 4th SCLK (the first four SDO bits are don't care)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.6 Table 1, p.12 Figures 5-6: A000h plus 12-bit data

commands.name: FIFO read
commands.note: p.6 Table 1, p.11 Figure 4: FIFO contents on SDO D15-D6 (already shifted from CS fall), D5-D0 don't care

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3-4 (terminal functions), p.5 (output format), p.6 (Table 1 commands), p.7 (Table 2 CFR), p.8-9 (modes), p.10-13 (Figures 2-8), p.19-20 (ROC, timing), p.21 (self-test, tconv)
notModeled: analog inputs, pseudo-differential input (CFR D7), internal/external reference (CFR D11) and REFP/REFM span (stored only; the result is the 0 V code)
self-test commands B000h/C000h/D000h start a conversion but output the 0 V code instead of 200h/000h/3FFh (p.21)
CFR power-on value: not documented; the datasheet requires a write CFR with 000h (A000h) at power up to select the host mode (p.6). Reset 0 here
FS (DSP frame sync) is not modeled: FS tied high (SPI mode, FS = 1 at CS fall); with FS active SDI is sampled on SCLK falling edges and SDO changes on rising edges (p.6)

repeat, sweep and repeat-sweep modes (CFR D6-D5 = 01/10/11), the sweep sequences (D4-D3), the 8-level FIFO and its trigger levels (D1-D0): only one conversion per trigger, no FIFO; INT asserts after every conversion
SW power down (8000h), auto power down and the PWDN pin wake-up by CS/CSTART; PWDN low is modeled as a powerdown pin (bus ignored)

short/long sampling (CFR D9) and conversion clock SCLK or SCLK/2 (CFR D8): the conversion is clocked by SCLK (14 x DIV / fSCLK); the model uses td(SCLK-INTL) 3.5 us max (p.20) as the conversion time for every setting
the conversion starts after the 16th (or 28th) SCLK; the model starts it at CS rise after a select command
INT also puts SDO in 3-state while CS is low; SDO is 3-stated after the 16th bit (idle z); read CFR is valid only in mode 00 (p.7)
codeFormat: CFR D10 = 0 unipolar straight binary (0 V = 000h); D10 = 1 two's complement where REFM (0 V) reads 200h (p.5), which is written as "offset" (the 0 V code 1 << 9)
the first conversion after power up or power down is not valid (p.19); SCLK up to 20 MHz, sampling and transition-time limits
variants: TLC1518 (8 channels, 20 pins) shares the datasheet; TLC1514 uses only the even TLC1518 channel codes (Table 1)
